blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.
blocks.zh: 视频传播变压器的推论成本占主导地位。 基于集群的稀疏关注集群既包括查询,也包括密钥,让一个集群中的所有查询共享一个选定的关键集群. 我们显示,这种共享限制精度:随着关键集群和密度的固定,随着查询集群的完善,注意力越来越准确,当每个查询自行选择时最准确,这根本不需要查询集群. 因此,我们提议Per-Query Routed Sparse Record(PQRS),这是一种无训练的方法,它只将密钥集群,让每个查询选择自己的密钥集群,用它们的百分数来补偿未选中的密钥集群. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video diffusion transformers denoise token sequences whose length sets their cost: Wan2.1 [ 28 ] at 720p with 81 frames denoises N = 75,600 N=75{,}600 tokens, and self-attention over them is quadratic in N N and accounts for most of the 28 minutes a five-second clip takes on an H100 [ 35 , 25 ] . Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only the token pairs that carry most of the attention mass. Most methods select over blocks of contiguous tokens, and contiguity in a video latent does not imply similarity: tokens that respond to the same keys are often far apart in raster order. Clustering-based methods [ 35 , 21 , 25 , 45 ] remove this mismatch by grouping tokens by content, and among training-free methods they currently give the best fidelity at a given cost.
blocks.zh: 视频传播变形器 denoise 令牌序列,其长度设定其成本: Wan2.1 [28] at 720p,装有81帧 denoises N = 75,600 N = 75,6{,5} 600 令牌,对它们的自我关注在 N N 中是四分法,并且占了每5秒的剪辑需要的H100 [35,25] 的28分钟的大部分时间. sparse关注通过只计算携带大部分关注质量的符号对来降低这一成本. 大多数方法从毗连的符号块上选择,而视频潜伏中的连续并不表示相似性:响应相同键的符号通常在光栅顺序上相距很远. 基于集群的方法[35, 21, 25, 45]通过按内容分组符号来消除这种不匹配现象,在无培训的方法中,它们目前以一定的成本给予最好的忠诚。

blocks.en: Keys and queries are clustered for different reasons. Keys are clustered so that a query can select at cluster granularity. Queries are clustered so that the selection can be executed: when a whole query cluster shares one selection, each selected pair of clusters becomes a dense block for a block-sparse kernel. But the shared selection also fixes what each query may see, and a query that attends differently from its cluster mean is handed the mean’s keys. Holding the key clusters and the density fixed, we find that recall rises and compensated output error falls as the query clusters are refined, with one query per cluster the most accurate. Even when each query cluster is scored by the attention mass it actually receives, so that the score carries no estimation error, a shared selection still trails per-query routing. The sharing itself is what costs accuracy.
blocks.zh: 密钥和查询因不同原因而分组. 密钥被分组,这样一个查询就可以在集群颗粒性时选择. 查询被分组,这样可以执行选择:当整个查询分组共享一个选择时,每对选定的分组成为块-sparse内核的密集块. 但共享选择也修正了每个查询可能看到的东西,一个与其集群平均值不同的查询会被递递给该平均值的密钥. 保持关键集群和密度固定下来,我们发现,随着查询集群的完善,每个集群有一个查询最准确,提醒上升和补偿输出错误下降。 即使每个查询组被它实际得到的注意力质量所打分,因此得分不带估计错误,共享选择仍然会跟踪每个水流的路由. 分享本身就是需要准确性。

blocks.en: Per-query routing needs no query clusters at all, so it removes a step rather than adding one. Query clustering is not free either: a k k -means pass compares every token against every centroid, the same order of cost as scoring every query against the key centroids once. The finest granularity is therefore not the more expensive option. What stands in the way is the shape of the work rather than its volume: tensor cores multiply a tile of queries against a tile of keys, and such a tile pays off only when its rows attend to the same keys, which is why two-sided clustering groups queries before they select [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: per-query的路由完全不需要查询集群,因此它去掉一个步骤而不是添加一个步骤. 查询集群也不是免费的:一个k k - 意思是通过比对每个百分数的每个令牌,成本顺序与每个查询对关键百分数的评分相同. 因此,最好的颗粒性并不是更昂贵的选择。 障碍在于作品的形状而不是其体积: 变压核心将查询的瓦片乘以瓦片的键,这样的瓦片只有在其行处理相同的键时才会得到回报,这就是为什么在选择 [35] 之前进行双面分组查询的原因.

blocks.en: We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS) , which clusters only the keys and lets every query select on its own. Each query scores the key centroids, ranks the clusters by estimated attention mass, and keeps the top clusters whose cumulative mass reaches p p ; the selected clusters are computed densely, and the rest are compensated through their centroid summaries using the scores the routing has already produced. Since no tile of consecutive queries now shares a key list, our kernel traverses key clusters instead: within a group of similar clusters it buckets the queries by which members they chose, so that queries with the same selection form a dense task, and execution is shared only where the hardware requires it. Partial results accumulate in place under a fixed offset taken from the log-sum-exp of the previous denoising step, which removes the rescaling of online softmax and lets the kernel finish in a single pass.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议Per-Query Routed Sparse Record(PQRS),它只将密钥分组,让每个查询自行选择. 每个查询对关键百分数进行评分,按估计的注意力质量对星团进行排序,并保留其累积质量达到p 的顶级星团;选定的星团计算得很密集,其余星团则利用路径已经生成的分数通过它们的中心行星摘要进行补偿. 由于没有连续查询的瓦片现在共享一个密钥列表,我们的内核转录密钥集群:在一组类似的集群中,它将它们选择的成员的查询装桶,这样,使用相同选择的查询就形成了密集的任务,只有在硬件需要时才共享执行. 部分结果在取自前一个解码步骤的对数和外观的固定抵消下累积到位,这消除了在线软max的缩放,让内核在一次通过中完成.

blocks.en: We evaluate PQRS on four 720p video DiTs covering text-to-video and image-to-video generation from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, with one configuration shared by all models and no training or per-model calibration. Against five training-free sparse attention baselines, PQRS attains the best PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS on every model while also being the fastest, with end-to-end speedups of 1.66 × 1.66\times to 2.10 × 2.10\times on a single H100. On VBench, which judges a video without reference to the dense output, we detect no degradation relative to dense attention. Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention compares frames from dense attention and PQRS. Our contributions are the following.
blocks.zh: 我们用四个720p的视频DiT来评价PQRS,这些视频涵盖Wan和HunyuanVideo家族的文本到视频和图像到视频生成,所有模型都共享一个配置,没有培训或每个模型校准. 在5个无训练的零散注意力基线中,PQRS在每个模型上都取得了最好的PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS,同时也是最快的,单H100上的端对端速度为1.66×1.66\时到2.10×2.10\时. 在V Bench上,它判断一个视频 而不提及密集的输出, 我们发现没有退化 相对于密集的注意力。 每条查询路线 Itself: 加速视频传播变形器 带有查询路线的 Per-Query Routed Sparse Records 比较 来自密集关注和PQRS的帧. 我们的贡献如下。

blocks.en: • We locate the accuracy cost of clustering-based sparse attention in the shared selection rather than in the clustering. • We propose PQRS, a training-free method in which every query routes over key clusters on its own and compensates the rest through their centroids, together with a cluster-major kernel that executes these irregular selections at tile efficiency in a single pass. • On four evaluated 720p video DiTs, PQRS attains the best PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS against five training-free baselines while also being the fastest, with end-to-end speedups of 1.66 × 1.66\times to 2.10 × 2.10\times and no degradation detected on VBench.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Static methods exploit spatiotemporal locality in video DiTs [ 10 , 28 ] with head-wise spatial or temporal masks [ 31 ] , sliding tiles [ 41 ] or energy-decay masks [ 16 ] , while dynamic methods estimate block importance online [ 39 , 33 ] or search the mask at a few steps and reuse it [ 32 ] . Following content-based clustering in language models [ 22 , 27 ] , clustering-based methods permute similar tokens into contiguous blocks: SVG2 [ 35 ] clusters queries and keys separately and selects cluster pairs by centroid scores, and SVOO [ 21 ] , AdaCluster [ 25 ] , HyperVAttention [ 12 ] and SCOPE [ 43 ] refine its clustering. SVG-EAR [ 45 ] , PISA [ 14 ] and Sol-Attn [ 13 ] approximate rather than drop unselected blocks, and trainable methods learn the routing [ 40 , 30 ] . To use block-sparse kernels, most training-free methods share one key selection across the queries of a block or cluster; TRA [ 1 ] assigns per-query budgets but still executes a block-sparse mask, and SparsePR [ 24 ] regroups queries by their responses to key clusters. PQRS instead removes query grouping: each query routes over shared key clusters on its own.
blocks.zh: 静态方法利用视频 DiTs [10,28] 中的spatiotopal locity 位置,带有头像空间或时间口罩 [31],滑动瓦片 [41] 或能量减值口罩 [16] ,而动态方法则估计在线重要性 [39,33] 或用几步搜索口罩并重用 [32] . 在语言模型中遵循基于内容的集群[22,27],基于集群的方法将类似的符号固定成毗连块: SVG2 [35] 集群查询和密钥分别并按百分数分数选择集群对, SVOO [21], AdaCluster [25], HyperVatententy [12] 和 SOPE [43] 完善其集群. SVG-EAR [45],PISA [14] 和Sol-Attn [13] 相近而非投放未选的块,可训练方法学习路线[40,30]. 要使用块分隔内核,大多数没有训练的方法在块或集群的询问中共享一个关键选择;TRA [1] 分配每个query的预算,但仍执行块分隔掩码,SparsePR [24] 通过对关键集群的回复重新组合询问. PQRS转而删除查询分组:每个查询路线在共享的密钥集群上自行取消.

blocks.en: Per-query selection is common in LLMs, both in single-query decoding over KV pages or clusters [ 26 , 18 ] and in trainable architectures that route each token to key blocks or tokens [ 20 , 37 , 3 , 11 ] ; Squeezed Attention [ 6 ] also scores key-cluster centroids per query, but averages the scores over a query block in prefill. To execute per-query selections, MoBA [ 20 ] reorders queries by key block and merges partial outputs with online softmax, while FSA [ 34 ] and MSA [ 11 ] loop over key blocks outermost and merge buffered partial outputs in a separate kernel. PQRS follows this key-outer order but accumulates partial outputs in place with atomic additions, replacing online-softmax rescaling with a fixed per-row exponent offset. The offset is the log-sum-exp of the previous denoising step, which AdaSpa [ 32 ] observed to be stable across steps, analogous to the forward log-sum-exp reused in the FlashAttention-2 backward pass [ 2 ] and the shared maximum of FlashDecoding++ [ 5 ] . Within a group of similar key clusters, queries with identical selections share one tile rather than the union of their selections, much as Hydragen [ 9 ] batches queries over a shared prefix.
blocks.zh: Per-query选择在LLMs中很常见,无论是在KV页面或集群上的单query解码[26,18]中,还是在可训练的架构中,这些架构将每个令牌传递到关键块或令牌[20,37,3,11];Squeezed Note[6]也给每个查询的密钥-集群百分数打分,但是在预填的查询块上平均得分. 为了执行每个query选择,MOBA [20]按按键块重排查询顺序,并将部分输出与在线软max合并,而FSA [34]和MSA [11]在最外侧的关键块上循环,并将缓冲部分输出合并在一个单独的内核中. PQRS遵循这种按键输出顺序,但用原子加成来累积部分输出,用固定的每行缩放抵消取代在线软缩放. AdaSpa[32]观察到,该步骤在各步骤之间是稳定的,类似于FlashAttention-2后传[2]和FlashDecoding++的共享最大值的前进日志和Exp再利用。 [5]. 在一组相似的密钥集群中,具有相同选择的查询共享一个瓦片而不是其选择的结合,多如Hydragen[9]在共享前缀上分批查询.

blocks.en: Orthogonal to attention sparsity, fast solvers [ 23 , 19 ] and distillation [ 36 ] reduce the number of sampling steps, feature caching reuses computation across steps [ 44 , 17 ] , and quantization lowers numerical precision [ 15 , 38 ] .

blocks.en: 3 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 动机

blocks.en: Clustering-based sparse attention makes all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters, whereas per-query routing lets every query select its own, as Figure 2 illustrates. After Section 3.1 formalizes the shared selection, Section 3.2 shows that accuracy improves as the query clusters are refined down to single queries, which yields per-query routing. Section 3.3 shows that per-query routing also avoids clustering the queries, but that its irregular selections do not map onto the tiles of GPU attention kernels.
blocks.zh: 基于集群的稀疏关注使得一个集群中的所有查询都共享一个选择的关键集群,而每个流线让每个查询选择自己的,如图2所示. 第3.1节正式确定共同选择后,第3.2节显示,随着查询集群被简化为单一查询,从而产生每条溪流路线,准确性有所提高。 第3.3节显示,每排路由也避免了对查询的集群,但其不规则的选择不会映射到GPU关注内核的瓷砖上.

blocks.en: FLOPs alone do not determine the speed on GPUs, where tensor cores multiply a tile of typically 64 queries with a tile of keys, so a tile is efficient only when all of its queries attend to the same keys. Under per-query routing the queries of a tile generally attend to different keys, so PQRS reverses this order: each query selects its own key clusters, and queries with the same selection then share a tile.

blocks.en: Since the selections differ across queries, PQRS computes Line 11 of Algorithm 1 in cluster-major order, following KV-outer sparse attention kernels [ 20 , 34 , 11 ] : it traverses the key clusters and gathers, for each of them, the queries that selected it.

blocks.en: A key cluster holds few keys, so a task over one cluster is short along the keys, yet each of its queries must still be gathered and have its partial output atomically merged. PQRS therefore executes groups of G = 4 G=4 clusters, so that a query pays this cost once per group it hits rather than once per selected cluster. PQRS groups them greedily by the cosine similarity of their key means. The grouping runs before routing, and K K and V V are permuted so that each group is contiguous in memory.
blocks.zh: 一个密钥集群持有的密钥很少,因此一个集群上的任务在密钥上是短的,然而它的每个查询仍然必须被收集,并在原子上将其部分输出合并. 因此,PQRS执行G=4 G=4集群的分组,这样一个查询就能够支付每组点击一次而不是每组选定一次的费用。 PQRS由于他们的关键手段的余弦相似性而贪婪地将其分组. 编组在路由之前运行,K K和V V被穿透,使每个编组在内存中是毗连的.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate PQRS on four widely used video generation models: Wan2.1-T2V-14B, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B [ 28 ] and HunyuanVideo-T2V-13B [ 10 ] for text-to-video (T2V) generation, and Wan2.1-I2V-14B [ 28 ] for image-to-video (I2V) generation.

blocks.en: For quality, we measure the similarity between the videos generated with sparse and dense attention by PSNR, SSIM [ 29 ] and LPIPS [ 42 ] , and report the VBench score [ 7 ] averaged over subject consistency, background consistency, motion smoothness, aesthetic quality and imaging quality. For efficiency, we report the attention density, the fraction of query–key pairs computed exactly in the sparse attention calls, together with the end-to-end latency and the speedup over dense attention.
blocks.zh: 关于质量,我们测量PSNR、SSIM[29]和LPIPS[42] 所制作的视频的相似性,并报告V Bench的分数[7]在主题一致性、背景一致性、运动光滑性、美学质量和成像质量方面的平均分数。 为了提高效率,我们报告注意密度,在很少注意的呼声中精确计算出的查询对键的分数,以及端到端的延迟和超过密集关注的速度。

blocks.en: Following prior work [ 35 , 45 , 21 ] , we randomly sample 50 of the augmented VBench prompts [ 7 ] for T2V and 50 image–prompt pairs from VBench++ [ 8 ] for I2V.

blocks.en: We compare PQRS with state-of-the-art training-free sparse attention methods for video generation: SVG [ 31 ] , SVG2 [ 35 ] , SVG-EAR [ 45 ] , SVOO [ 21 ] and PISA [ 14 ] . All baselines use their official configurations, except for the shared warm-up below and the density hyperparameter. Table 1 lists the resulting densities.

blocks.en: PQRS uses C k = 592 C_{k}=592 key clusters, a routing threshold of p = 0.848 p=0.848 and a routing floor of f = 0.10 f=0.10 on all four models. Following [ 45 , 14 ] , every method computes dense attention in the first 20% of denoising steps and in the first block of each transformer stack. All methods, including dense attention with PyTorch SDPA, share the same non-attention operators, so latency differences come from attention alone. Videos are generated at 720p with the official sampling configuration of each model on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, and further details are given in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 compares PQRS with five sparse attention baselines on four video diffusion models, covering both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. PQRS consistently achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on all four models, surpassing SVG-EAR, which runs at a comparable density, as well as SVG, SVG2, SVOO, and PISA, which compute more attention. Since each query selects key clusters according to its own attention distribution, PQRS retains the attention mass that a shared selection misses, and the generated videos stay closest to the dense outputs. On the reference-free VBench metric, PQRS remains on par with dense attention across all four models, and the qualitative comparisons in Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention further confirm that it preserves the visual quality of the dense outputs.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了PQRS在4个视频传播模型上的5个稀疏关注基线,既包括文本到视频,也包括图像到视频生成. PQRS在所有四个型号上都一贯实现最好的PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS,超过了运行密度相当的SVG-EAR,以及SVG,SVG2,SVOO,和PISA,计算出更多的关注度. 由于每个查询都根据自己的注意力分布来选择关键集群,所以PQRS保留了共享选择缺失的注意力量,生成的视频保持最接近密集输出. 在无参考的V Bench 度量标准上,PQRS与所有四种模型的密集关注保持相同,在"每个查询路线本身:加速视频扩散变换器与Per-Query Routed Sparse Record"中的质量比较进一步证实它保持了密集输出的视觉质量.

blocks.en: PQRS also delivers the highest inference efficiency on every model, reaching 1.66–2.10 × \times end-to-end speedup. Although per-query routing produces an irregular selection pattern, the cluster-major kernel in Section 4.2 executes it efficiently, so the finer selection does not come at the cost of speed. As a result, PQRS improves fidelity and inference speed at the same time on all evaluated models, achieving a better quality–efficiency trade-off than existing sparse attention methods.
blocks.zh: PQRS也为每个模型提供最高的推论效率,达到1.66–2.10×\times端对端加速. 虽然每条流线产生不规则的选择模式,但第4.2节中的集群主内核能高效地执行,因此更精细的选择不会以速度为代价. 因此,PQRS同时提高所有被评价模型的忠诚度和推论速度,比现有的稀少关注方法实现更好的质量效率权衡。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose PQRS, a training-free sparse attention method for video DiTs. Since sharing one selection across each query cluster limits accuracy, PQRS clusters only the keys, lets every query select its own key clusters, and approximates the unselected ones by their centroids. A cluster-major kernel packs queries with identical selections into dense tasks and merges their partial results in a single pass. On four video generation models, PQRS is faster and more faithful to dense attention than all five baselines, reaching 1.66–2.10 × \times end-to-end speedup.
blocks.zh: 我们提议PQRS, 一种免费的零散关注方法 视频DiT。 由于在每一个查询集群之间共享一个选择限制准确性,PQRS集群只使用密钥,让每个查询选择自己的密钥集群,并按其百分数对未选择的密钥集群进行近似. 集群主内核将相同选择的查询打包成密集任务,将其部分结果合并为单传. 在4个视频生成模型上,PQRS比所有5个基线都更快,更忠实于密集的注意力,达到1.66–2.10×\times端对端速度.

blocks.en: The attend and compensation kernels are written with CuTe and CUTLASS for H100, selection and task construction in CUDA, and the remaining stages in Triton. All inputs are BF16.

blocks.en: Each sparse call clusters the keys of each head, after QK normalization and RoPE, into C k = 592 C_{k}=592 clusters with the k-means kernel of SVG2 [ 35 ] . The first sparse call runs 50 iterations. Each later call runs 2 iterations from the centroids of the previous call of the same layer, in either guidance branch. Grouping is greedy: the largest unassigned cluster opens a group, which then repeatedly takes the unassigned cluster with the largest summed cosine similarity to its centroids until it holds G = 4 G=4 clusters. Keys and values are permuted so that each group is contiguous in memory, and a task reads the selected members of a group as at most two contiguous segments.
blocks.zh: 每个稀疏的调用组合每个头的键,在QK正常化和ROPE之后,组成C k = 592 C_{k}=592 的调用组合,并带有SVG2的k-意为内核[35]. 第一次通话是50次重复 每一次以后的调用都从同一层的上一个调用的中间体中运行2个迭代,在任意一个制导分支中. 分组是贪婪的:最大的未分配集群打开一个集群,然后反复取出与它的百分数相近的无分配集群,直到它持有G=4 G=4集群. 密钥和值被穿透,使每个组在内存中是毗连的,一个任务将一组中选定的成员读作最多两个毗连部分.

blocks.en: One matrix multiplication scores all queries against all key centroids. Selection assigns one warp to each query, finds the threshold of Section 4.1 by bisection over the scores held in registers, and writes the 4-bit code of every group with a warp ballot. Task construction then buckets the queries of each head and band of query rows by group and code. A separate kernel first writes the compensation into the FP32 accumulators. The persistent attend kernel then loads keys and values with TMA, computes with wgmma and adds its partial results to the accumulators with vectorized atomic reductions.
blocks.zh: 一个矩阵乘法对所有密钥中心机器人进行所有查询. 选择为每个查询指定一个曲速,在登记册中记录的分数上通过二节查找第4.1节的阈值,并以曲速选票写出每个组的4位码. 任务构建然后按组和代码将每个查询行头和波段的查询装桶。 一个单独的内核首先将补偿写入FP32累积器. 持久性的出席内核再用TMA加载密钥和值,用wgmma计算,并以矢量原子还原法将其部分结果加进累积器.

blocks.en: At the last dense step, PQRS calls the FlashAttention kernel behind SDPA directly. It returns the same output together with the LSE, which gives the offsets of the first sparse step. Rows outside the safe range are appended to a list in device memory. The repair kernel reads the length of this list on the device and returns at once when the list is empty, so the host never synchronizes. As Table 3 shows, repair is rare. On the two prompts of Figure 5 , almost all repaired rows underflow, and they concentrate in the last two layers and the last two denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 在最后密集的一步,PQRS直接将SDPA后面的闪存内核称为闪存内核. 它和LSE一起返回相同的输出,这给出了第一个稀疏步骤的抵消. 安全范围以外的行被附加到设备内存中的列表中. 修补内核读取设备上此列表的长度,当列表为空时立即返回,因此主机永远不会同步. 如表3所示,修理很少。 在图5的两条提示上,几乎所有修复的行都下流,它们集中在最后两层和最后两层去诺舞步上.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Row repair on the 50 evaluation videos. Rows is the fraction of (head, row) pairs in sparse calls that are repaired, and Calls is the fraction of sparse calls with at least one repaired row.
blocks.zh: 表3:50个评价视频的排修情况。 行是零星呼叫中(头,排)对数的分数,被修复,而Calls则是至少有一行被修复的零星呼叫的分数.

blocks.en: The two experts have separate layers, and only the expert active at the last dense step receives the dense LSE. In the other expert, the first sparse call of each layer therefore computes its offsets exactly with a pre-pass over the selected keys and runs k-means for 50 iterations. All later calls use the cached LSE.
blocks.zh: 两位专家有独立的层次,只有活跃在最后密集步骤的专家才能得到密集的LSE. 在另一位专家中,每一层的第一个很少的呼号,因此精确地用在选定的密钥上的前传计算其抵消,并运行了50次迭代的k-表示. 所有后来的通话都使用缓存的LSE.

blocks.en: HunyuanVideo attends jointly over the video tokens and 256 text tokens, of which the trailing ones are padding. PQRS sparsifies only the attention of video queries to video keys, and the density counts only this part. Each video query also attends to all valid text keys with one FlashAttention call, and the two parts are merged exactly through their LSEs. Text queries attend densely to all valid keys and padding rows only to padding, as in the official SVG2 code. The offsets of the first sparse step are the dense LSEs minus the contribution of the valid text keys.
blocks.zh: 湖南 Hun 视频在视频信物和256个文本信物上联合出席,其中后继信物是粘贴的. PQRS只将视频查询的注意力用在视频密钥上,密度只算这部分. 每个视频查询还处理所有有效的文本密钥,并有一个FlashAttententy呼叫,两个部分完全通过它们的LSE合并. 文本查询对所有有效的密钥进行密集的处理,而加挂行只用于加挂,如官方的SVG2代码. 第一个稀疏步骤的抵消是密集的LSE减去有效文本密钥的贡献.

blocks.en: Wherever attention is dense, in the dense baseline and in the dense steps and blocks of every method, it runs PyTorch SDPA with the FlashAttention-2 backend, as in the official SVG code. For the other operators, all methods including the dense baseline use the fused Triton kernels of SVG and SVOO, in which we fixed a LayerNorm bug that included zero-padded columns in the variance. The speedups reported by the SVG family use the original Diffusers operators for the dense pipeline and these fused kernels for the sparse one, so they also count the gain of kernel fusion. Our speedups use the fused kernels on both sides.
blocks.zh: 在注意力密集的地方,在密集的基线和每种方法的密集步骤和块中,它会像正式的SVG代码一样,用FlashAtthinding-2后端运行PyTorch SDPA. 对于其他操作者,包括密集基线在内的所有方法都使用SVG和SVOO的熔化的Triton内核,其中我们固定了一个LayerNormbug,在差异中包含零加列. SVG家族报告的速度使用原始的Diffuses操作器进行密集的输油管,这些被熔化的内核用于稀疏的输油管,因此它们也计算了内核聚变的增益. 我们的速度使用了两侧的引信内核.

blocks.en: Three baseline configurations needed adaptation. • SVG-EAR on HunyuanVideo. The official code passes the zero-filled centroids of the padding text tokens to the compensation, which adds a term absent from dense attention to the denominator of every video row. We exclude the prompt and padding clusters from the compensation and compute the prompt columns exactly. • PISA. PISA provides no inference script for Wan or HunyuanVideo, so we call its kernel directly. Because the kernel takes no mask, on HunyuanVideo we remove the padding tokens and, as its documentation recommends for MMDiT models, use the last block as the attention sink. When the valid text spans more than one block, only the last block is guaranteed to be exact, which slightly disadvantages PISA. • SVOO on Wan2.2. The official profile of SVOO for Wan2.2 was collected with a different shift and guidance scale. We reuse it because the profile only sets a per-head lower bound on the budget, which is clipped to [ 0.20 , 0.22 ] [0.20,0.22] and lies well below the density of SVOO in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 需要调整三个基线配置。 • HunyuanVideo上的SVG-EAR。 官方代码将贴纸文字符号的零填充百分位通过补偿,这给每个视频行的分母增加了一个因密集关注而缺席的名词. 我们从补偿中排除了迅速和补足的集群,并准确地计算了迅速的柱子。 • PISA.
